observations: A large rounded form fills most of the frame, rendered in layered grey and pale yellow washes with a bright circular highlight near the upper center, against a black field scattered with small white dots.

Two eyes sit asymmetrically: the left is loosely sketched with a pale iris, the right is more tightly drawn with a vivid green iris and black pupil, both surrounded by loose black outlines that double and drift.

An open mouth near the lower center shows a grid of small rectangular shapes in grey and off-white, edged in orange-red lines; the surrounding face lines are thin, scratchy, and overlap without fully closing.
reading: The rounded form reads as a helmet visor, its reflective surface suggested by overlapping pale washes and a bright bloom of light near the top. The two eyes differ enough in finish that they feel like separate moments of attention caught inside the same enclosure. The open, gridded mouth adds a note of strain or surprise. The dotted black surround keeps the whole image suspended.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #103 and nnxyz nnotb #105. Where #103 uses a flat black silhouette against open teal, #104 fills its field with layered washes and overlapping lines — a strong contrast in density across adjacent titles.

connections.reason: Scrimshaw7 shares the same basic face structure — two eyes, open toothed mouth, loose overlapping outlines — but replaces the cool grey-yellow palette and enclosed rounded form with dense multicolor lines radiating outward; the collector links both artists through this shared face-and-line vocabulary.

Title neighbor nnxyz nnotb #103 offers a direct contrast: a flat black silhouette with a single yellow eye against open teal, versus #104's dense layered washes and doubled lines filling the entire field.
